concept.title: Manual review, deviations, and exception boundaries
concept.shortdesc: BPM surfaces CIS-related manual review when local governance can change the correct deployment decision.

section.title: Manual-review scope
section.p: BPM marks manual review for nine paths: AppAutoUpdate, BackgroundAppUpdate, DisableAppUpdate, DisableSystemAddonUpdate, Proxy.Locked, Proxy.Mode, SanitizeOnShutdown.FormData, SanitizeOnShutdown.History, and SanitizeOnShutdown.Sessions. These paths are review points because enterprise patch management, proxy routing, and evidence-retention rules can legitimately differ between deployments.

section.title: Update governance
section.p: Review AppAutoUpdate, BackgroundAppUpdate, DisableAppUpdate, and DisableSystemAddonUpdate with the owner of enterprise patch management. Verify whether browser updates are governed by Firefox, an operating-system tool, a software-management platform, or a separate maintenance window. BPM can preserve the selected value and source attribution, but it does not decide which update process is operationally correct.

section.title: Proxy routing
section.p: Review Proxy.Locked and Proxy.Mode with the network owner. Verify whether the profile must preserve system proxy behavior, enforce a manual proxy, or leave routing to another control. Do not treat a BPM value as proof that traffic actually used the intended route after deployment.

section.title: Evidence retention
section.p: Review SanitizeOnShutdown.FormData, SanitizeOnShutdown.History, and SanitizeOnShutdown.Sessions with the security and privacy owner. Some hardened scenarios clear local data, while some investigations require retaining evidence. BPM records the choice and conflict state; it does not determine the legal or incident-response requirement.

section.title: Exception boundary
section.p: BPM has no separate persisted CIS exception or waiver model. Record intentional deviations in an external ticket, deployment note, or change-control record, then keep the BPM profile source attribution and manual_review_kept_base decision visible for later review. Imported, manual, converted, raw, unavailable, or blocked certificate/trust states also require review; they are not proof of benchmark compliance.

section.title: Current 0.9.6 behavior
section.p: Schema, starter preset, and CIS baseline are selected before the saved profile is created. Baseline, CIS, manual, imported, converted, and raw attribution supports review; it does not prove compliance. Certificates and trust have a separate path-level ledger, and manual, imported, converted, raw, unavailable, and blocked states require manual review.
